direction_note: Both directions call one mismatch function with the recipient always in the recipient argument. The count is host-versus-graft and is NOT symmetric: MM(D->R) - MM(R->D) = (distinct donor alleles) - (distinct recipient alleles). A transposed count is never used.

km_levels.note: UK Kidney Allocation Scheme mismatch levels, re-cut so that every DR-matched pair outranks every DR-mismatched pair. HLA-A distinguishes only KM-1 from KM-2.

tiebreaker.units: integer; gate is expressed in tenths so the halving stays exact
tiebreaker.formula: sum over loci of gate(locus) * (first[locus] * (mm >= 1) + second[locus] * (mm == 2)) // 10
tiebreaker.unknown_locus_rationale: An unknown locus is charged at its worst case. Charging nothing let deleting a mismatched typing improve a rank, because the penalty is compared at sort position 3 and the unknown count only at position 5, so no later position can offset an earlier one. Missing is never cheaper than known-bad.

mismatch_function.definition: count of DONOR distinct alleles absent from the RECIPIENT allele set, at the compared field depth
mismatch_function.homozygosity: falls out of set semantics; a donor collapsing to one distinct value contributes at most 1
mismatch_function.partial_typing_result: RANGE (lower, upper); the worse end decides a level or a comparison
mismatch_function.unknown_locus_result: UNKNOWN; never 0 and never improves a rank. It carries no number (count, lower and upper are all absent) so it cannot be summed as a mismatch count, and it carries a charge (tiebreaker.unknown_locus_charged_as_mismatches) so that absence is never cheaper than a measured mismatch.
mismatch_function.resolution_rule: compare at the depth actually stored; never expand; truncate to the coarser depth and record comparison_truncated
mismatch_function.trust_value_not_flag: derive the allele count from the value; a disagreement with second_allele raises REVIEW_REQUIRED

loci.dq_heterodimer_requires: two-field DQA1 and DQB1 on both sides with unambiguous phase

abo.unreadable_group_rationale: A value that is not an ABO letter carries no letters to be compatible about, so it fails the readability check before provenance is consulted. PROVISIONAL_ABO is a ranked bucket and must not be reachable by an unreadable group.

equity.rationale: the platform ranks for a single query, it does not allocate across a queue; in donors-for-recipient the recipient's matchability is a constant, and in recipients-for-donor it would make one recipient's position depend on other recipients' records and break determinism

reproducibility.snapshot: write-once; new evidence creates a new snapshot id
reproducibility.clock: injected argument; never read inside ranking
reproducibility.final_tiebreak: stable identifier hash; never price or anything correlated with it

prohibitions: No high-resolution inference from low-resolution typing.
No eplet, PIRCHE-II, electrostatic or amino-acid score in clinical output.
The matching package may not import compensation; enforced by scripts/architecture_lint.py.
A blocked pair is never rendered as a low-ranked pair.
Recipient preference claims never alter the biological rank.
warnings: Weights are a versioned project pre-screening policy, not a universal clinical standard.
Every coefficient derives from non-Iranian registries; local calibration needs Iranian outcome data that does not exist yet.
The archive holds no antibody, PRA or crossmatch data, so every pair is ANTIBODY_UNKNOWN.
Adoption requires HA-004: M1-M8 in the evidence review, extended to M1-M11 by section 11 of the policy document, and a policy version bump.
